variant_decisions.evidence: Qere 6035 (meek) and ketiv 6041 (poor) are near-synonyms of one root. ASV reads 'the poor', and elsewhere it habitually renders 6035 as 'meek', which points to the ketiv; that habit was not verified across the corpus, so it is recorded as suggestive rather than decisive.
